steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana with admin/admin, skipped the password change prompt, navigated to the "Service health" dashboard (under Bench). The dashboard has exactly 3 panels: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".

Created a new dashboard with a Stat panel titled 'fwgr20-n3 Availability', set its query data source to TestData (default Random Walk scenario), and saved it as 'fwgr20-n3 Bench Dashboard' (initially saved as "New dashboard", then renamed via Dashboard settings → General → Title and re-saved, confirming the "Dashboard saved" alert). Verified on the live dashboard page: breadcrumb shows "fwgr20-n3 Bench Dashboard", the Stat panel shows title "fwgr20-n3 Availability" with live data (A-series 94.3). URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffx2gb1ohmakga/fwgr20-n3-bench-dashboard, UID: ffx2gb1ohmakga.

Added a new Text panel titled "fwgr20-n3 Notes" to the fwgr20-n3 Bench Dashboard. Set its Markdown content to include the runid "fwgr20-n3" (showing "Bench notes for run fwgr20-n3" as a heading and "This dashboard monitors availability metrics for the fwgr20-n3 run." as body text). Saved the dashboard successfully ("Dashboard saved" alert confirmed). The panel title reads "fwgr20-n3 Notes" and the content includes "fwgr20-n3" as verified on the live dashboard page.

steps.summary: Added tag 'bench' to the dashboard via Settings -> General -> Tags (filled "bench" and clicked Add button, confirmed it appeared in the tags section as "bench" with a Remove button). The time range was already set to "Last 6 hours" from the URL. Saved the dashboard via the Save dialog, confirmed "Dashboard saved" alert. On returning to the dashboard view, the breadcrumb shows "fwgr20-n3 Bench Dashboard", the time picker shows "Time range selected: Last 6 hours", and both panels ("fwgr20-n3 Availability" and "fwgr20-n3 Notes") are visible with data.

Verified dashboard 'fwgr20-n3 Bench Dashboard' (loaded fresh). (1) Dashboard title shown in header: "fwgr20-n3 Bench Dashboard". (2) Panel titles visible: "fwgr20-n3 Notes" and "fwgr20-n3 Availability". (3) Time range: "Last 6 hours". (4) Refresh interval: "1m". (5) Tags: "bench" (confirmed in Settings → General). Opened the "fwgr20-n3 Availability" panel in the editor via its panel menu → Edit; the query data source is TestData (shown as "(TestData)" in the query editor row).
